description: An input-validation-policy artifact defines type constraints, size limits, sanitization rules, and bounds for every user-supplied input field in an API or form.

rules.description: Policy must declare the feature it covers.
Each field must declare id, name, and type.
Fields of type string, text, email, url, password, etc. must declare a positive maxLength to prevent buffer overflow and DoS via oversized input.
Fields of numeric type must declare min and max to prevent overflow and business logic abuse.
Fields of type html, markdown, sql, url, redirect_url, or with names like 'comment', 'body', 'search', 'query' must declare a sanitization strategy.
Every field must declare at least one validation rule (required, maxLength, min/max, pattern, enum, format, or sanitize).
File/upload fields must declare allowed_mime_types (non-empty array) and max_size_bytes or max_size_mb.
File fields must not allow dangerous extensions: .exe, .sh, .bat, .php, .asp, .js, .html, etc.
